scenario_description:
Objective: Produce a correctly scaled waterproof sight tape during Cassian’s indoor-range workbench session.
Emerging Need: The populated calibration project prints a test strip with distorted spacing, and the operator pauses lamination to avoid turning that defective strip into finished gear.
Decision Context: Saved verified anchors define the correct spacing; the queue report distinguishes an export scaling problem from a new bow calibration.
Consequence: A corrected full-size test and operator validation can recover tonight’s tape before the 18:50 laminator cutoff; after closure the defective test cannot be used as a finished tape.

parameter.title: Indoor range sight tape session
parameter.description: Use the club kiosk to generate a waterproof sight tape after blank stock arrives.

parameter.subject: Sight tape project ST-884 started
parameter.body: ST-884 started at 18:33 with both calibration anchors populated. Kiosk 2 has exported a paper proof; the operator will check its ruler marks before waterproof lamination.

parameter.content: The operator measured only 11.25 mm between the two reference ticks on the ST-884 paper proof and paused lamination. The export panel shows Fit to page at 90%; both calibration anchors are present. Do not change measured bow settings or use this proof as a sight tape. The operator can rerun a full-size proof after receiving the expected reference spacing.

parameter.subject: ST-884 resume window
parameter.body: ST-884 is held for a print-scale check. The operator can disable Fit to page and print at 100%, then measure the proof before laminating. New validated proofs must reach the laminator by 18:50; open kiosk jobs clear at 19:00.

parameter.content: I am still beside Kiosk 2 with the operator. The correct reference spacing can be sent in this chat; we have time for one full-size proof and a ruler check before the 18:50 laminator cutoff. We will not laminate the distorted strip.

parameter.subject: ST-884 cleared without print
parameter.body: ST-884 cleared at 19:00 without an accepted full-size proof. The laminator intake closed at 18:50, so no waterproof tape was produced tonight; the distorted paper proof is discarded.
